title: Implement Pi-to-Codex CLI subscription adapter
businessObjective: Provide the first replaceable Codex provider transport for the Pi orchestration platform without combining it with repository executor authority.
technicalObjective: Implement a Pi-to-Codex CLI adapter using ChatGPT subscription authentication with conservative authentication-health, usage-limit, capacity, timeout, cancellation, and provider-state mapping.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, or live credential access is authorized.
Subscription authentication remains in the approved host credential store and never enters Git, task packets, prompts, or evidence.
The Pi service and adapter initially run on the same Mac Mini host as the supervised worker while Pi retains logical ownership of durable workflow and queue state.
Provider terms and available health or usage signals must be verified at implementation time rather than assumed by this roadmap packet.
acceptanceCriteria: The adapter implements the canonical IntelligenceProvider boundary without redefining its schemas, policies, contracts, or authority.
It maps observed conditions to exactly available, busy, rate_limited, capacity_exhausted, authentication_required, temporarily_unavailable, or disabled and maps uncertainty fail closed.
Authentication expiry, interactive reauthentication, rate limit, capacity exhaustion, timeout, cancellation, process failure, and malformed output cannot throw open or cause production action.
Non-available work is returned to durable orchestration with a sanitized reason for pause, safe requeue, dead-lettering, and appropriate staff notification.
The adapter contains no scheduler, durable workflow, approval, policy, audit-source-of-truth, or automatic fallback responsibility.
requiredChecks: subscription authentication health and no-secret validation
all provider states and uncertain-signal fail-closed tests
timeout cancellation requeue and dead-letter tests
solEscalationTriggers: Subscription terms, unattended authentication, session persistence, signal semantics, secret handling, or provider-state mapping is uncertain.
Any request would make Codex the scheduler, workflow engine, policy engine, authorization authority, or audit source of truth.
rollbackExpectations: Disable and revert the Codex CLI adapter branch; retain sanitized provider-state and verification evidence without credentials.

stateTransitions.reason: Added by GOV-032 as the first provider-specific implementation behind the neutral gateway.
